description: The walk can now fetch named data into the pool (named-shape bind, live since 4678802/faa0afc/0c4e81f/cc8c3cd) but cannot construct an llmCompletion payload from those pool records, so every analysis goal terminates exactly at the compute step. Run f59199e7 (goal 9f7cfb62, the standing analysis probe): substrateGap records fetched into the pool (step 5), memoryNote terminal correctly deferred refusing a confabulated body (step 6), learned-composition-llmcompletion-to-memorynote-write ran and FAILED (step 7, nothing produced the llmCompletion it consumes), llmCompletion itself deferred as an unconstructible terminal (step 8), walk terminated 'missing shapes [llmCompletion] have no producer or constructible payload' (step 11). The llm arms are advertised and healthy; what is missing is ARG-SYNTHESIS: building the completion request (prompt = the goal's analysis instruction + the pool's substrateGap records as context) from what the walk already holds. The walk already threads pool shapes into COMMANDS deterministically ('threaded pool shapes into command deterministically' exists for shellResult args); the equivalent binding for llmCompletion prompts is absent. Falsifier: re-dispatch the standing probe goal (hash 9f7cfb62, text stored at /tmp/probe.json in the container and in the parent gap analysis-goals-never-bind...); the walk must produce an llmCompletion whose request demonstrably contains at least one open gap id from the pool, and the stored note gap-class-clusters-2 must contain at least one real open gap id. OPERATOR NOTE: four instance-level walk fixes were operator-landed to reach this point (bind, prose-guard, tool-noise filter, compute injection); this gap is deliberately LEFT TO THE LOOP - hand-authoring prompt construction would cross from access infrastructure into authoring the investigator itself, which the knowledge-loop roadmap forbids.
